comparison.objective: Install a thermometer clamp and thermometer on a laboratory stand versus commission an industrial shock absorber.
comparison.physical_skill: Carry and tighten a clamp, squeeze spring handles, insert and orient a thin thermometer versus seat a hex key, unlock and rotate a collar, counterhold, relock, and test impacts.
comparison.success_condition: Clamp mounted, thermometer secure within 20°, tip immersed, scale visible versus repeated non-bottoming stopping performance and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Generic tightening and bimanual stabilization do not establish overlap; the tested assembly and dynamic-calibration abilities differ.
